items.title: Augmenting AI with the Power of Jakarta EE
items.summary: Building production-grade AI requires more than a model. It requires an ecosystem. The Java Community provides this ecosystem for the modern enterprise. Paired with Jakarta EE, it creates a formidable platform for AI Augmentation.Come to this session to learn how to orchestrate enterprise-ready AI agents using Jakarta EE technologies in combination with AI augmentation approaches, such as tools, skills, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
